memories.content: Jane Zhao is the CEO of NovaTech Inc. She must decide whether to approve the Q3 performance bonus for the engineering team. She is aware that the team exceeded Q2 targets. She has her own criteria and considerations for bonus approval, and she will make the decision by the board meeting on September 15, 2026.

NovaTech Inc. has a policy for performance bonuses. The engineering team exceeded Q2 targets. The board meeting is scheduled for September 15, 2026, where the bonus decision will be finalized. CEO Jane Zhao is the decision-maker.
